claims.text: Second-line: mycophenolate mofetil (preferred) or tacrolimus; most patients need lifelong maintenance, ideally with a glucocorticoid-sparing agent.
claims.quote: Second-line treatments include mycophenolate mofetil (preferred) and tacrolimus; multiple salvage therapies have been described. Most patients ultimately require lifelong maintenance therapy, ideally with a glucocorticoid-sparing agent
